name: M3_PMS100MI_SearchMO
description: Searches for Manufacturing Orders given many different search criteria.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number of the item manufactured on the order.

inputParameters.name: PRIO
inputParameters.description: Priority of the manufacturing order for planning and scheduling.

inputParameters.name: WHST
inputParameters.description: Current status of the manufacturing order in the production process.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse where the manufactured product on the order will be produced or stored.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number to assign to the manufactured item on the order, if predefined.

inputParameters.name: TXT1
inputParameters.description: Free text line 1 for additional information about the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: TXT2
inputParameters.description: Free text line 2 for additional information about the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: STDT
inputParameters.description: Planned start date of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: FIDT
inputParameters.description: Planned finish date of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RSDT
inputParameters.description: Actual start date when the manufacturing order was first reported.

inputParameters.name: REFD
inputParameters.description: Actual finish date when the manufacturing order receipt was reported.

inputParameters.name: RPDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the latest reporting transaction for this manufacturing order was performed.

inputParameters.name: ORQT
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order in the basic unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in the alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: MAUN
inputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the manufacturing order quantity is expressed.

inputParameters.name: RVQT
inputParameters.description: Quantity received for the manufacturing order in the basic unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: RVQA
inputParameters.description: Quantity received for the manufacturing order expressed in the alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: MAQT
inputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MAQA
inputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order expressed in the manufacturing unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number, such as a customer or purchase order, linked to the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order linked to the manufacturing order, such as customer or purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PCDO
inputParameters.description: Status indicating whether order costing and production statistics have been performed for the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: CFIN
inputParameters.description: Configuration number uniquely identifying the product configuration for the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MSTI
inputParameters.description: Planned start time of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MFTI
inputParameters.description: Planned finish time of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: ACTP
inputParameters.description: Planning action message indicating suggested actions for the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: NNDT
inputParameters.description: Alternate planning date proposed by the system when rescheduling the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: SCHN
inputParameters.description: Schedule number grouping the manufacturing order in production planning.

inputParameters.name: HDPR
inputParameters.description: Main product number associated with the manufacturing order, if any.

inputParameters.name: RIFD
inputParameters.description: Filter date from which reschedule-in proposals are evaluated for the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: ROFD
inputParameters.description: Filter date from which reschedule-out proposals are evaluated for the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: TSDA
inputParameters.description: System timestamp date for the manufacturing order record.

inputParameters.name: TSTE
inputParameters.description: System timestamp time for the manufacturing order record.

inputParameters.name: PULD
inputParameters.description: Pull-up control used for delayed manufacturing orders in advanced planning and scheduling.

inputParameters.name: PULN
inputParameters.description: Pull-up control used for non-delayed manufacturing orders in advanced planning and scheduling.

inputParameters.name: SUBN
inputParameters.description: Sub-network identifier used to group the manufacturing order within a planning network.

inputParameters.name: PRAP
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order has been processed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

inputParameters.name: CLGP
inputParameters.description: Color group used to visually categorize the manufacturing order in the scheduling workbench.

inputParameters.name: NTWP
inputParameters.description: External network priority used when integrating the manufacturing order with external planning tools.

inputParameters.name: ACHD
inputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order was last changed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

inputParameters.name: ACHT
inputParameters.description: Time when the manufacturing order was last changed by the advanced planning and scheduling tool.

inputParameters.name: RGDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order was created.

inputParameters.name: RGTM
inputParameters.description: Time when the manufacturing order was created.

inputParameters.name: LMDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order header was last changed.

inputParameters.name: CHNO
inputParameters.description: Change number associated with the latest update of the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: CHID
inputParameters.description: User ID who last changed the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix used to distinguish sub-lines on the reference order line linked to the manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: MREC
inputParameters.description: Manual reclassification date when the manufactured lot may be moved from quality status 1 to 2.

inputParameters.name: MRCT
inputParameters.description: Time of day on the manual reclassification date when the manufactured lot may be reclassified.

inputParameters.name: AGBF
inputParameters.description: Setting indicating whether backflush issue transactions for the manufacturing order are aggregated or handled in detail.

inputParameters.name: MOLK
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the manufacturing order is locked for changes, for example by an external system.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number of the item manufactured on the order.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order linked to the manufacturing order, such as customer or purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number, such as a customer or purchase order, linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix used to distinguish sub-lines on the reference order line linked to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: WHST
outputParameters.description: Current status of the manufacturing order in the production process.

outputParameters.name: ORQT
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the manufacturing order in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: MAQT
outputParameters.description: Accumulated manufactured quantity for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PRIO
outputParameters.description: Priority of the manufacturing order for planning and scheduling.

outputParameters.name: STDT
outputParameters.description: Planned start date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MSTI
outputParameters.description: Planned start time of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FIDT
outputParameters.description: Planned finish date of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MFTI
outputParameters.description: Planned finish time of the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.
